launch_distributed_training: launch distributed SLURM training jobs from YAML config files with submitit
run_batch_config_launch: run multiple config files as a batch SLURM job array using --batch-launch flag
create_trainer_checkpoint: create a Trainer instance with checkpoint support for resuming preemption in SLURM jobs
build_code_snapshot: build a timestamped code folder copy with ignored patterns for reproducible job environments
update_folder_timestamp: update output folder paths with timestamps when checkpoint loading is disabled
